description: `def take(n, <<s :: binary-size(n), _ :: binary>>)` reports "undefined variable \"n\"" with the caret under `s`, because `BitSize::Var(String)` in the AST has no span and the producer uses the field value's span (pattern.rs pin_for_name call site). Elixir points at `n`. Fix: `BitSize::Var` carries a Spanned name from the parser; pin_for_name records it. One parser change, one field. Signal: the head_size_pins_nothing fixture's expected.stderr moves its caret to the size name.
title: A bitstring size name carries no span, so its diagnostic points at the field value
